title: Coordinate lifting for parameter-preserving power-series maps
statement: Let $R=\Lambda_R[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ and $T=\Lambda_T[[Y_1,\ldots,Y_m]]$ be regular local power-series rings [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let $i:R\to T$ be a local ring map. Let $t$ be a regular system of parameters of $R$ and $y$ a list in $T$ such that $(i(t),y)$ is a regular system of parameters of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Assume either $\Lambda_R$ and $\Lambda_T$ are both characteristic-zero fields, or both are Cohen rings for the same prime $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and the first entry of $t$ is $p$. Equip $T$ with its $R$-algebra structure from $i$. Let $L=\mathfrak m_R T$; equip $T/L$ with its quotient algebra structure over $R/\mathfrak m_R$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. If $T/L$ is formally smooth over $R/\mathfrak m_R$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_T$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then $T$ is formally smooth over $R$ for its $\mathfrak m_T$-adic topology.

proof.text: For a continuous square-zero lifting problem T -> N/J over R, the quotient map makes J a T-module because J^2 = 0. If the map kills m_T^e then m_T^e J = 0. Filter J by J_a = {j : m_T^a j = 0}. The successive quotients are annihilated by m_T. Descend from N/J_e to N/J_0. A lift killing m_T^b modulo a square-zero kernel kills m_T^(2b), so every stage remains continuous. The action on the next kernel is the original action since changing representatives by J has zero product with J.

Thus assume m_T J = 0, making J a vector space over the residue field K of T. Tag 07NM gives coordinates t,y (with p omitted as a variable in the Cohen case). Tag 07NL gives an unrestricted lift over Q or Z. In characteristic zero N is a Q-algebra: integers are units modulo J, and a unit modulo a square-zero ideal lifts to a unit. Keep the coefficient map and change the t-variable values to their prescribed images from R; the variable images are nilpotent, so evaluation uses finite truncations. The new lift agrees on all parameters of R, including p.

Its defect on R is a derivation into J, annihilating the parameters. The universal property of differentials and the exact quotient differential sequence make it factor through Omega_(k/Z), where k is the residue field of R: the R-action on J factors through k, and the differentials of the parameters generate the conormal image. Tensor this k-linear map with K.

Formal smoothness of the closed fibre gives injectivity of Omega_(k/Z) tensor_k K -> Omega_(T/m_R T / Z) tensor_T K by Tag 07EL. Extend the defect functional along this injection by extending a vector-space basis. Compose with the differential of T -> T/m_R T to obtain a derivation D' on T whose restriction to R is the defect. Subtract D' from the unrestricted lift. Leibniz and J^2 = 0 prove multiplicativity; derivations kill 1. The correction vanishes modulo J and cancels the defect on R, so the corrected lift is R-linear. Apply this at every stage of the filtration in step 1. This solves all lifting problems. Empty parameter lists and the case J = 0 require no parameter correction.

theorem formallySmoothAdic_of_parameters_closedFiber
    (ΛR : Type u) (ΛT : Type v) [CommRing ΛR] [CommRing ΛT] (n m : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT)]
    (i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT) [IsLocalHom i]
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR))
    (y : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT))
    (ht : IsRegularSystemOfParameters t)
    (hy : IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map i ++ y))
    (hcoeff : (IsField ΛR ∧ IsField ΛT ∧ CharZero ΛR ∧ CharZero ΛT) ∨
      ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛR ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛT ∧
        t.head? = some (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)) :
    let R := MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR
    let T := MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛT
    letI : Algebra R T := i.toAlgebra
    let L : Ideal T := (maximalIdeal R).map i
    letI : Algebra (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap (Ideal.le_comap_map :
        maximalIdeal R ≤ L.comap (algebraMap R T))
    Algebra.FormallySmoothAdic (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L)
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk L)) →
      Algebra.FormallySmoothAdic R T (maximalIdeal T)
